spec.title: Container OOM Events (1h)
spec.description: Containers with one or more cgroup OOM events in the last hour.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_oom_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",pod!=""}[1h])) > 0) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "cluster", "No OOM events", "", "")

spec.title: Deployments Healthy
spec.description: Deployments meant to be running that are. Ones deliberately scaled to zero are not counted, so this plus Degraded is less than the total whenever something is parked.

spec.title: OOMKilled Containers
spec.description: Containers that exist right now and whose last exit was an OOM kill -- a standing state, not a rate, so unlike the (1h) tiles around it there is no window. It clears when the pod is replaced, which in practice is quick: over the last 30 days this read non-zero for one hour out of 720. For OOM activity within a window, use "Container OOM Events (1h)" below, which counts cgroup events instead and can legitimately disagree with this.

spec.title: Pod Phase Count
spec.description: Every phase is drawn, including the ones at zero, so a flat line at zero means no pods are Pending or Failed rather than that nobody is looking.

spec.title: PVC Inode Usage (%)
spec.description: Percentage of filesystem inodes used by each PVC. Inode exhaustion can occur before disk capacity is full.

spec.title: Top CPU Throttled Containers (5m)
spec.description: Percentage of CPU scheduling periods throttled in the last 5 minutes. Idle containers and zero values are excluded. The window is fixed at 5 minutes and does not follow the dashboard range.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, (100 * sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",pod!=""}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",pod!=""}[5m])), 1e-9)) > 0)) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "cluster", "No throttling", "", "")

sort_desc(sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h])) > 0) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "cluster", "No restarts", "", "")
